answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the nectar of free entry disappears, the onyx of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the falcon case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
